LESSON: WRITING 12.4.1 GUIDED COMPOSITION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition, part of Strand 12 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we keep a record of what we do? 2. What information do we record?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the components of a diary for effective writing,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. write a diary in the right format for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.
